=== Levels 30+: Agility Pyramid ===
[[File:Agility Pyramid (7).png|thumb|width=200x200|A player training on the Agility Pyramid.]]
The [[Agility Pyramid]] is a straightforward, profitable method of training agility with little requirements. Before reaching higher levels the failure rate may slow progress, but each completion of the pyramid awards a [[Pyramid top]] worth {{NoCoins|10000}} [[coins]] when traded to [[Simon Templeton]]. Roughly 13 completions can be made per hour at early levels (30-50), for {{NoCoins|130000}} gp/hour and 25,000 experience per hour. Upwards of 26 completions per hour can be made at higher levels, (70-99), for {{NoCoins|260000}} gp/hour and approximately 44,000 experience per hour.
